title: Archers, pikes and riders at tunnels, rituals and town gates
changes: Hide-Kin tunnels now send out burrow-spears and boar riders with their foot soldiers.
Veiled ritual circles are guarded by a sun-caster standing inside the circle and a dune rider.
Town gate guards now put their pikes on the road side and their archers behind them, for clans that field them.
Tunnel soldiers and gate guards in these roles are slightly lighter, so tunnels and gates stay about as hard as before.
